entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was having a massage and cocktail..."
entries.dialogueText: I was having a massage and cocktail on the balcony of Palas Toras, high above Monqiz. The sun was setting, its rays shimmering on the water and illuminating the Rumburgian flags flying over the port.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My masseuse handed me a towel as I..."
entries.dialogueText: My masseuse handed me a towel as I got up. Fully adept at blending business with pleasure, I reached for my cocktail and told the attendent I'd be taking the call in the pool.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I did, the attendant ran a telep..."
entries.dialogueText: As I did, the attendant ran a telephone out to me, setting it on the pool's edge.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He informed me that Wiktor Smolak w..."
entries.dialogueText: He informed me that Wiktor Smolak was on the other end of the line.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Good evening, Your Majesty. I hope..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good evening, Your Majesty. I hope I am not disturbing your regal downtime."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good evening, Mr. President. To wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good evening, Mr. President. To what do I owe the pleasure?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why did you call?""
entries.dialogueText: "Why did you call?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I wasn't disturbed before. Now I a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wasn't disturbed before. Now I am."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""My my. Last I recall, Rizians were..."
entries.dialogueText: "My my. Last I recall, Rizians were a bit more welcoming than that."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""So tell me... how are you doing, Y..."
entries.dialogueText: "So tell me... how are you doing, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""None of your business.""
entries.dialogueText: "None of your business."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm well. And you?""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm well. And you?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Savoring the high life in one of m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Savoring the high life in one of my many palaces. You know?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""As a matter of fact, I do.""
entries.dialogueText: "As a matter of fact, I do."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I'm currently partaking in the ver..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm currently partaking in the very same indulgence."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Alright, I will cut to the chase.""
entries.dialogueText: "Alright, I will cut to the chase."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Oh, you know how it is. Purging my..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, you know how it is. Purging my cabinet of infiltrators, taking out 'personal loans' from the treasury department..."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Listen, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Listen, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I have a proposition for you...""
entries.dialogueText: "I have a proposition for you..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The water suddenly felt cold agains..."
entries.dialogueText: The water suddenly felt cold against my skin.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""One you might find to be of intere..."
entries.dialogueText: "One you might find to be of interest."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am listening.""
entries.dialogueText: "I am listening."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Make it quick.""
entries.dialogueText: "Make it quick."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What is it?""
entries.dialogueText: "What is it?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""How is your little war going?""
entries.dialogueText: "How is your little war going?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He took another drag."
entries.dialogueText: He took another drag.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Cut to the chase.""
entries.dialogueText: "Cut to the chase."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's none of your business.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's none of your business."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Very well, thank you. A full victo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very well, thank you. A full victory is at hand."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It could be better.""
entries.dialogueText: "It could be better."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I thought so.""
entries.dialogueText: "I thought so."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Oh, really? Well, that's good. Tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, really? Well, that's good. That's good. Yeah."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""A man of few words, are you?""
entries.dialogueText: "A man of few words, are you?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Here's what I think, if I may be s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Here's what I think, if I may be so bold..."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Imagine standing on your palace ba..."
entries.dialogueText: "Imagine standing on your palace balcony, watching the sun dip in the west."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If I didn't know any better, I'd i..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I didn't know any better, I'd interpret that as a veiled threat."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And then?""
entries.dialogueText: "And then?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you out of your mind?""
entries.dialogueText: "Are you out of your mind?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Now. Now. No need to be so tense.""
entries.dialogueText: "Now. Now. No need to be so tense."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Here comes the good part.""
entries.dialogueText: "Here comes the good part."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What exactly is this glorious army..."
entries.dialogueText: "What exactly is this glorious army doing?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I use my army...""
entries.dialogueText: "I use my army..."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""...to help you win your war in Pal..."
entries.dialogueText: "...to help you win your war in Pales."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""So how about that?""
entries.dialogueText: "So how about that?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He took another drag."
entries.dialogueText: He took another drag.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And what do you want in return?""
entries.dialogueText: "And what do you want in return?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you for your generosity. Of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for your generosity. Of course we would accept Wehlen's unconditional assistance."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm hanging up.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm hanging up."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Hold on. Hold on.""
entries.dialogueText: "Hold on. Hold on."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Now hold on a minute... there's no..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now hold on a minute... there's nothing unconditional about this."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I'm offering a trade. Zille for Pa..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm offering a trade. Zille for Pales."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""That's my price. Accept, and Pales..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's my price. Accept, and Pales will be yours for the taking."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""The offer expires the moment I han..."
entries.dialogueText: "The offer expires the moment I hang up. Thoughts?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Absolutely not. What made you thin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Absolutely not. What made you think Rizia can't win without Wehlen?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'd rather not give up Zille. Perh..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd rather not give up Zille. Perhaps, there's another option we can explore?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I heard a clink as he put the pipe..."
entries.dialogueText: I heard a clink as he put the pipe down. His tone shifted to a much more serious one.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""This deal isn't negotiable. It's Z..."
entries.dialogueText: "This deal isn't negotiable. It's Zille or nothing."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Too bad. A pity.""
entries.dialogueText: "Too bad. A pity."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Very well. I agree to your conditi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. I agree to your conditions, but only if you follow through with your side of the bargain."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took a moment to mull over his pr..."
entries.dialogueText: I took a moment to mull over his proposal. Could I really trade Zille for Pales?

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""So what do you think? Do we have a..."
entries.dialogueText: "So what do you think? Do we have a deal?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I thought about it for another brie..."
entries.dialogueText: I thought about it for another brief moment.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Excellent! And of course, I'll fol..."
entries.dialogueText: "Excellent! And of course, I'll follow through. You have my word."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I could picture his wide grin in my..."
entries.dialogueText: I could picture his wide grin in my head.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I made my offer.""
entries.dialogueText: "I made my offer."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I wish you a good night, Your Maje..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish you a good night, Your Majesty. And good luck in your war."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good night, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good night, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope to never hear your voice ag..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope to never hear your voice again."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Piss off.""
entries.dialogueText: "Piss off."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""That makes two of us.""
entries.dialogueText: "That makes two of us."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He hung up."
entries.dialogueText: He hung up.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: End();

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Then my people will talk to your p..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then my people will talk to your people and we will be all set."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""You definitely are a man of reason.""
entries.dialogueText: "You definitely are a man of reason."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I wish you a good evening, Your Ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish you a good evening, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I'm eager to attend the victory ce..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm eager to attend the victory celebrations in Pales, hosted by none other than King Romus himself."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good evening.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good evening."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They'll surpass your wildest expec..."
entries.dialogueText: "They'll surpass your wildest expectations, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Should you betray me, I'll make su..."
entries.dialogueText: "Should you betray me, I'll make sure both you and your nation suffer the consequences."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""An interesting proposal... But how..."
entries.dialogueText: "An interesting proposal... But how do I know you won't renege?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""We will sign an agreement, of cour..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will sign an agreement, of course! I trust your foreign affairs councilor to make sure everything is airtight."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""You're speaking my language, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're speaking my language, Your Majesty! I look forward to hearing all about all the dirty details!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I muttered the words to no one befo..."
entries.dialogueText: I muttered the words to no one before submerging myself in the pool.

entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""So how are you, Your Majesty?""
entries.dialogueText: "So how are you, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Just another day at the office.""
entries.dialogueText: "Just another day at the office."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well, don't keep me in suspense. T..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, don't keep me in suspense. The anticipation is absolutely killing me!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a noticeable pause before..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a noticeable pause before he took another drag. I suspected my sarcasm might have missed its mark.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""The unmatched glory that is the ar..."
entries.dialogueText: "The unmatched glory that is the army of the Republic of Wehlen."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Suddenly, just as its fading light..."
entries.dialogueText: "Suddenly, just as its fading light teeters over the horizon, you spot a glimmer of gold amidst the shadows--"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""As you're undoubtedly aware, Wehze..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you're undoubtedly aware, Wehzek troops boast a legendary reputation."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "On the one hand, accepting Wehlen's..."
entries.dialogueText: On the one hand, accepting Wehlen's aid could tip the scales in our favor, but aligning with the likes of Wikor Smolak could leave us indebted to him indefinitely.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "On the other hand, if Smolak's inte..."
entries.dialogueText: On the other hand, if Smolak's intentions were true, a decisive victory over Pales could be within our grasp.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Not to mention, risk tarnishing our..."
entries.dialogueText: Not to mention, risk tarnishing our reputation with our international partners, especially if we were to lose the war.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I understand the importance of tru..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand the importance of trust and honoring one's commitments -- especially to a soon-to-be brother in arms!"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Just think... this one phone call..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just think... this one phone call will inevitably change the course of history. No doubt about it!"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Well, I've had some pretty wild dr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, I've had some pretty wild dreams, but I'll trust you on this one!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A military alliance with Wiktor Sm..."
entries.dialogueText: "A military alliance with Wiktor Smolak... what have I gotten myself into... "

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Pales is within my grasp. I can fe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pales is within my grasp. I can feel it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've almost finished what my fathe..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've almost finished what my father started. "The Rizian flag *will* fly over Pales once more."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I set my phone down, I reflected..."
entries.dialogueText: As I set my phone down, I reflected on what just transpired.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He hung up."
entries.dialogueText: He hung up.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I said the words out loud to no one..."
entries.dialogueText: I said the words out loud to no one before submerging myself in the pool.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A military alliance with Wiktor Sm..."
entries.dialogueText: "A military alliance with Wiktor Smolak... I can't believe I even considered it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Pales is within my grasp. I can fe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pales is within my grasp. I can feel it. Not even a two-bit dictator like Wiktor Smolak will make me think otherwise."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I set my phone down, I reflected..."
entries.dialogueText: As I set my phone down, I reflected on what just transpired.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "Screw Smolak... I will finish what..."
entries.dialogueText: Screw Smolak... I will finish what my father started. The Rizian flag *will* fly over Pales and Zille, once more."

entries.dialogueText: I was having a massage and cocktail on the balcony of Palas Toras, high above Monqiz. The sun was setting, its rays shimmering on the water and illuminating the Rizian flags flying over the port.

entries.dialogueText: "It's too late for that, Mr. President. Zille is a part of Rizia again."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Listen here, Smolak. Your puny lit..."
entries.dialogueText: "Listen here, Smolak. Your puny little troops will only interfere with the unstoppable juggernaut that is the Rizian Armed Forces. Consider your offer declined."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""The only difference is that this t..."
entries.dialogueText: "The only difference is that this time, our ownership of Zille will be permanent."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""But who need dusty old Zille anywa..."
entries.dialogueText: "But who need dusty old Zille anyway? Not when you've got full control over South Merkopa's largest new natural gas source..."

entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""It's never too late for another ag..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Have you opened a newspaper lately..."
entries.dialogueText: "Have you opened a newspaper lately? We're closing in on the Palesian capital. We don't need help from you or anyone else."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""And here I thought you were doing..."
entries.dialogueText: "And here I thought you were doing all that as a token of friendship. Not because of some dusty old piece of land."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Think about it, Your Majesty. Who..."
entries.dialogueText: "Think about it, Your Majesty. Who needs Zille when you have full control over South Merkopa's largest new natural gas source?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Do you own a crystal ball, Your Ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you own a crystal ball, Your Majesty? Nothing's decided until the people cast their vote."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Think about it. Lose both the refe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Think about it. Lose both the referendum and the war, and you'll have lost two regions. Accept this deal, and you're guaranteed to gain one."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia calling on the Wehzek army f..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia calling on the Wehzek army for help? It's been done."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""And it worked, didn't it?""
entries.dialogueText: "And it worked, didn't it?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Please elaborate.""
entries.dialogueText: "Please elaborate."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""It's simple. After we help you win..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's simple. After we help you win the war, Rizia and Wehlen will sign a land transfer agreement, just like your father did."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And what if your troops fail? We'l..."
entries.dialogueText: "And what if your troops fail? We'll lose two regions in one go."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Don't you worry, Your Majesty. If..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't you worry, Your Majesty. If Pales is lost, our agreement will be void. Zille will be yours."
